nodes.label: SEC received complaints and had opportunities to independently verify Madoff's claimed trading, but did not act on them before the collapse
Fabricated client statements and trade confirmations sustained the appearance of a legitimate operation
The Ponzi scheme continues operating for decades
The scheme collapses and Madoff is arrested (December 2008)
Madoff pleads guilty to all 11 felony counts (2009-03-12)

edges.rationale: Missed independent-verification opportunities documented by the SEC OIG allowed the fabricated trading narrative to continue unchallenged.
Fabricated statements and trade confirmations sustained investor and regulator confidence.
The scheme's operation precedes its December 2008 collapse and Madoff's arrest.
The arrest precedes the March 2009 guilty plea.
The guilty plea precedes the June 2009 sentencing.

allowed_changes.label: Independent third-party verification of claimed trades after a documented regulatory complaint
allowed_changes.description: Model an independent third-party verification of Madoff's claimed trading activity occurring after one of the documented SEC complaints or examinations, instead of the verification opportunity being missed.

direct_effects.description: The fabricated trading narrative could have faced an earlier, independent challenge instead of continuing unchallenged.

downstream_possible_effects: Detection of the fabricated trading records could possibly have occurred earlier than December 2008, though no specific earlier date is established by this source pack.
The scope of additional investor losses accumulated after the missed verification opportunity could possibly have been reduced, though no specific avoided-loss amount is established.

unchanged_facts.text: Madoff's own guilty plea and criminal liability for operating the scheme are established facts independent of this hypothetical.
The 150-year sentence imposed on 2009-06-29 is the actual, final outcome of the real case and is not altered by this hypothetical.

unknowns: The exact earlier detection date, if any, cannot be determined from this source pack.
Whether independent third-party verification would have been technically or procedurally feasible at that time is not established.
Any alternate sentence, forfeiture amount, or legal outcome cannot be inferred from this hypothetical.
allowed_changes.mandatory_hypothetical_disclaimer: This is a bounded educational hypothetical about detection likelihood, not a prediction, guarantee, or alternate legal verdict.
